transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi there, I'm Dora, a clinical conversational agent. I can help answer your questions about cataract surgery recovery. Do you have any questions about your surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. First, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You should avoid any exercise for 1 week after surgery, but you can then go back to light exercise, such as brisk walking, gardening, light jogging, and gentle cycling.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: That's helpful to know, thank you. My next question is, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: If you were using any eye drops before your operation, such as for glaucoma, or for dry eyes, it's safe to continue using them, unless you've been told otherwise.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Great, thanks for clarifying that. I've noticed I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Although it's normal for the eyes to be a bit sensitive to light as it adjusts to the new lenses, significant pain when it's bright or severe light sensitivity is not normal, especially if your eye is also red and painful, and we may need to assess this further. Otherwise, if it's mild and things just seem brighter than you're used to, we'd recommend just wearing sunglasses when you're going outside. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, one more. Should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It’s common for the vision to not be completely clear in the first week after your operation. But this should improve quickly and settle down over time. If your vision is still blurry, or getting significantly worse or blurry, we may need to check it to make sure it’s okay. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that's all I wanted to ask. Thank you for the information!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You're welcome! So, just to confirm, have all your questions been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, all my questions have been answered. Thank you!

verdict.label: pass
